note: Decoded original SEB frame records for the battle fighter animation path. Frames are 1:1 with the original files; no timing is invented here. Each record carries its SEB line index (line 0 = shadow, line 1 = body) because Seb.GetSprite(frame, line) is a per-line lookup. Monster clips are decoded from the intact originals in RE-evidence/20260911-treasure/monster-original; human clips still come from the legacy extracted tree.
